topics.label: Introduction to Cancer Evolution and Lecture Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture series, outlines core concepts of cancer progression, and presents the key learning objectives.

topics.label: Clonal Selection and Epigenetic Drivers of Tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cell-intrinsic genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations confer selective growth advantages that drive clonal evolution.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and the Cancer Stem Cell Model
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how normal tissue hierarchies, stemness properties, and specific cells of origin determine susceptibility to malignant transformation.

topics.label: Microenvironmental Influences and the Multi-Factorial Model of Cancer Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how inflammatory and stromal microenvironments promote tumor outgrowth, the technologies used to study these interactions, and the resulting unified evolutionary model.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic closes the session and announces the topic for the subsequent lecture.
